name: io.github.Makkov-design/framelens
title: Frame Lens
description: Eyes and ears for AI agents: measured cuts, easing, palette, beats and transcripts from any video.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Google Gemini API key, only for the Gemini YouTube tools; the local tools need no key.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_MODEL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Gemini model for the Gemini tools.

environmentVariables.name: FRAMELENS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Folder for results; defaults to .framelens in the working folder (or ~/.framelens).

environmentVariables.name: FRAMELENS_AUTO_INSTALL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 0 to stop the automatic, hash-checked download of a missing ffmpeg or yt-dlp.
